transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I came in because my eating has gotten all turned around. It's been like this for months now. Some days I just pick at toast and coffee, and other days I find myself standing in the bakery aisle buying sweets I don't even really enjoy.
Have you been worried about gaining weight or feeling unhappy with your body shape?
No, not really. I haven't been worrying about my weight or how my body looks. It's not because I'm trying to diet or anything like that... my appetite is just all over the place for no real reason.
Have you noticed that you don’t enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once liked?

Yeah, I have. I used to really get excited about things... like doing my quilting squares, or going to bowling night, and planning potlucks. But lately, I just look at my sewing supplies or the church calendar, and... I just can't make myself care the way I used to. The interest just isn't there anymore.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past couple of weeks?

Yes, I have. Most days I wake up with this... heavy, sad feeling just sitting on me. It doesn't really go away, either. Even when I'm in my bright kitchen with the coffee going in the morning, I just feel like the warmth has gone out of everything. It's been like that pretty much every day for a while now.
Have you felt unusually tired or found that you're lacking energy for everyday tasks, even when you haven't done anything physically demanding?

Yes, I have. Um... even when I actually get a full night of sleep, like on the nights when my aunt doesn't call out for me, I still feel completely worn down by breakfast. It's just a heavy exhaustion. Doing simple things... like carrying a basket of laundry or just making a few phone calls, it just takes so much more out of me than it really should.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight recently, like losing or gaining more than usual?

Yeah, I have. Actually, that's a big part of why I came in... my eating has just gotten all turned around for months now. Some days I just pick at a piece of toast and have my coffee, and I don't want anything else. But then other days, I'll find myself just standing in the bakery aisle at the grocery store, buying all these sweets that I don't even really enjoy. It's just all over the place, so my weight has definitely been fluctuating because of it.
How long have you been feeling this way most days — this heavy sadness and loss of interest in things?
It's been going on for about seven months now. It really started right around the time my aunt moved in with me, after she had a bad fall. I've just felt this way pretty consistently since then.
Have you noticed that it's harder to think clearly or focus on tasks, like following a recipe or keeping track of a conversation?

No, I haven't really noticed any problems with that. I mean, I can still follow a recipe fine and keep up with what people are saying to me. My thinking seems pretty clear, honestly. It's just the sadness and the energy that are the main problems.
Have you noticed that you've been moving more slowly than usual, or that you can't sit still and feel restless?

Yeah, I definitely move slower. People have actually started asking if my hip is bothering me, just because I move so slow through the grocery store these days. And it's not just walking... it takes me forever to just answer a simple question at meetings. So, no, I'm not restless, just... really sluggish, I guess.
